title: Workflow Automation

listing.shortDescription: Connect business tools and automate repetitive processes using intelligent workflows.
listing.fullDescription: Your tools already hold the data — the work is getting them to agree with each other. We design workflows that move information between systems reliably, with idempotent steps, dead-letter handling and alerting when something breaks. Where a no-code platform is the right answer we use one; where it would become a liability we write code.

deliverables.title: Process mapping
deliverables.description: The current-state flow, its failure points, and the target-state design.

deliverables.title: Orchestrated workflows
deliverables.description: Retries, idempotency keys, rate-limit handling and a dead-letter queue for anything that fails.

deliverables.title: Alerting and runbooks
deliverables.description: Notifications on failure plus written recovery steps your team can follow.

deliverables.title: Handover documentation
deliverables.description: Diagrams and notes so your team can extend the workflows without us.

useCases: Scheduled data syncs and nightly reconciliation
Approval chains with notifications and audit history
